replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
I am sorry to say but your map, Ambiguous, has been denied from testing for the Avicus Network.

To Improve your map, the map developers suggest you make the map a lot more bigger. This is mainly because the map is designed for TDM but is way too small. Another thing is to make the block pallette look better. At first sight, the map looked weird to me until I looked at the overview more. One final note is to not have too many small things that affect gameplay. These include lava patches, cobwebs, and ice.


If you have any other questions on how to improve your map, Find me on TeamSpeak or Message me on Skype (Sethskye).


You May resubmit your map once edited.
